subject: Request: one-time POC runway & credit uplift for Novan Health
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@novanhealth.com>, procurement <procurement@novanhealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: one-time POC runway & credit uplift for Novan Health

Hi Samir —

Quick context: Novan has been on our sandbox for three weeks. They’ve integrated our API for their clinical triage assistant and have run ~160k tokens/day the last 5 days (attached usage_report_q3.csv). They hit PLG limits yesterday (30-day sandbox cap) and are blocked from continuing meaningful regression tests and an SSO integration that requires a longer run.

Ask: Can Redwood approve a one-time 45-day POC runway extension and a one-off credit uplift (proposed: 50,000 token-equivalent credit) so Novan can finish validation? This is strictly a time-bound concession — pricing and contract terms remain standard for any paid contract.

Why we should do it:
- They are a midmarket prospect in behavioral health with strong product-market fit and an early procurement timeline (Q4 decision window).
- Engineering effort is high: they’ve done a staged integration with de-identified sample traffic; the remaining work requires live SSO + EHR connector tests that take additional cycles.
- We’ve seen similar one-offs convert at ~35% when given a short runway to validate flows.

Attachments: proposed_sow_novan.pdf (integration checklist) and usage_report_q3.csv.

Next steps I’m asking for from you: 1) Exec sign-off for the 45-day extension + 50k credit, 2) any required paperwork (we can do a one-page amendment and an internal approval note).

If approved, I’ll coordinate with legal/finance and loop procurement for the vendor onboarding items.

Thanks —
Laura
Laura Bennett
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com

---
Attachments: proposed_sow_novan.pdf (application/pdf), usage_report_q3.csv (text/csv)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Jul 2026 13:30:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Request: one-time POC runway & credit uplift for Novan Health

Aditya / Laura —

Summarizing the ask and recommendation so execs have a concise packet:

Deal summary:
- Account: Novan Health (behavioral health SaaS)
- Current stage: Sandbox validation, integration phase
- Ask: 45-day sandbox extension + 50,000 token-equivalent free credit (one-off)
- Upside: Prospect target ARR $180k/year if converted; procurement timeline Q4.

Recommendation (my POV): approve a conditional one-time concession:
1) 50k free tokens, valid only for the 45-day extension window. Unused credits expire at extension end.
2) No change to published pricing or SLA.
3) Require 2 success metrics to be met before conversion handoff: a) 2 production-ready flows validated end-to-end, b) weekly progress sync with AE + Eng.
4) Legal to sign a short amendment; finance to accept that this is a non-recurring promotional credit (no revenue impact beyond reporting).

Rationale: This is a low-dollar, high-signal opportunity. The credit request is modest relative to expected ARR and avoids setting a broad precedent because it's time-boxed and conditional.

Attachments: deal_terms_summary.docx (short internal memo). Also linking HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1234567/D-2026-0934.

If you approve, we’ll prepare the amendment and copy procurement. Laura, please confirm we’ll require the vendor_onboarding_form completed before we enable the extension.

Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference

---
> On Jul 7, 2026, at 09:12, Laura Bennett wrote:
> > Quick context: Novan has been on our sandbox for three weeks...

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Jul 2026 17:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: one-time POC runway & credit uplift for Novan Health

Thanks for the clear packet, Karthik. I’m granting provisional approval for the one-time concession with the following conditions:

1) Approve: 45-day extension and up to 50,000 token-equivalent credit.
2) Conditions:
   - Amendment signed by Novan (short form confirming extension + credit) and completion of vendor_onboarding_form.pdf.
   - Credits expire at the end of the 45-day window; no rollover.
   - Finance to be notified (finance_ops@redwood.com) and will track as promotional credit for FY26 reporting.
   - Required outcome: at least one validated production-ready flow during the runway; if none achieved, do not offer additional concessions without further exec review.
3) Marketing ask: if Novan converts within 6 months, request a customer reference / case study commitment where possible.

Laura: proceed to draft the amendment and coordinate with legal and procurement. Karthik: please log this decision on the HubSpot deal and attach this exec_approval_novan_20260707.pdf to the record.

Aditya Rao
Chief Revenue Officer, Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.com
